text_block_list.text:
While walking through the shopping 
district accompanying Agnes Tachyon on her 
errands—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"We've bought everything on the list. Now 
then, let's carry these bags back to the 
academy—"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Mm, what's that?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hoh, a raffle, is it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, I received a raffle 
ticket when I went shopping earlier.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It is a fine opportunity. Trainer-kun, go 
ahead and pull one.
choice_data_list: Are you sure you don't need to back down?
Are you sure you don't need to draw?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"...Don't you get it? I strictly want to 
devote myself to observation, you see."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Just how much one's emotions stir and 
facial expressions change from the color 
of a single ball.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If you understand, draw it quickly. And 
prove the link between emotion and facial 
muscles!

Overwhelmed by Agnes Tachyon's momentum, I 
was swept along toward the raffle counter—

You spun the lottery wheel! And the result 
is—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hoh, the grand prize...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Heh heh, not bad at all!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The way your face instantly relaxed from 
all that tension and lit up with pure 
joy...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: That was quite a fascinating sight!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Still, of all things to win, a hot 
springs trip voucher... Hmph."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: —Alright, I suppose I'll give this to you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Why, you ask? We live in an age where even 
travel can be done remotely.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Going all the way out of our way for a 
trip is nothing but a giant pain in the 
neck, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If you understand, take it. And feel free 
to invite a friend along.

Since I couldn't just force it back on 
them, I decided to hold onto the hot 
springs ticket for now.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ohh, this is great!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Juicy, meaty texture and vibrant 
carrots...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"If I slip it into this, any Umamusume 
will jump at it in an instant... Heheh!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ah, no, no, just talking to myself.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Regardless, let us return, Trainer-kun. 
Take utmost care not to let the hamburger 
steak lose its shape!

Sensing a slightly ominous atmosphere, I 
carried the deluxe carrot hamburg steak 
back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Huh, not bad at all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
With that much, we have plenty to prep 
what we bought today.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Either way, as long as it looks like a 
carrot, it's bound to lure in a few of 
them... Hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ah, no, no, just talking to myself.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"In any case, let us head back quickly, 
Trainer-kun. ...There is a little 
something I must attend to."

Sensing a slightly ominous atmosphere, I 
carried the massive pile of carrots back 
to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh... I like that look on you!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Holding a single raw carrot in plain view 
of the public—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Why, you look just like a guinea 
pig holding some treats!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Splendid, simply MARVELOUS! Do continue to 
be my obedient guinea pig, will you?

Feeling an indescribable emotion, I 
promptly put the carrots into the shopping 
bag.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh... Now that was an amusing sight.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The way a face full of expectation 
instantly turns to disappointment...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What an honest, delightful reaction. I had 
no idea emotions could show so clearly on 
someone's face.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Even so, to think I pulled a "blank"...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I'll take a pack of tissues just 
in case. They do come in handy whenever 
something spills.

Feeling downcast, I headed back to the 
academy together with Agnes Tachyon...
